# Add commit timestamp for compile runs

This feature adds a new column, commit_timestamp, to the compile_runs table to record the timestamp of commits for direct-push compiles. It allows for improved tracking and reconciliation of both pull request and direct-commit compile data by using COALESCE between commit_timestamp and merged_at.
